visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing black-rimmed glasses, a black t-shirt, and a black baseball cap stands in a professional hobby studio. He holds a large black box with a yellow lightning bolt and "GOD DAN" text. Shelves filled with colorful toy figures and boxes create a dense, detailed background environment with bright studio lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a tight close-up of the black box being opened. A hand uses a silver utility knife to slice through clear adhesive tape. The interior of the box is revealed to be bright yellow with black handwritten calligraphy. A grey garment sealed inside a transparent plastic bag is pulled out into the foreground. (3) The man displays a grey t-shirt, first showing the small white "God Dan" text on the front left chest. He then turns the shirt around to reveal a large, rectangular graphic on the back featuring a stylized blue and white lightning bolt surrounded by traditional Japanese ukiyo-e style clouds and pink floral patterns. (4) He holds up a black phone case decorated with a yellow lightning bolt and golden wave patterns. He then demonstrates a circular phone grip accessory with a matching logo. The background features more hobbyist items like a silver car model and a "NANLITE" lighting fixture, which are visible behind him. (5) A large, colorful concert poster graphic suddenly overlays the center of the screen, depicting several men flying through a blue sky. The main character remains visible at the bottom of the frame, gesturing with his fingers and smiling towards the camera. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout this final sequence.
